36309: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work.
126834: The main protagonist of Yuragi-sou no Yuuna-san. A skillful psychic who banishes spirits through his punches. He is poor and used to be homeless before arriving at Yuragi Inn.
127015: A girl who befriends Kogarashi after meeting him during the first day of high school. She is also a popular girl at school, known for her beauty.
127238: Yuuna is a ghost who is bound to the Yuragi Inn. She has no recollection of her life when she was alive and asks for Kogarashi's assistance in helping her discover who she was, developing an attachment to him in the process.
127440: A ninja from the Chuuma Village. She hails from the Ameno house, a clan specializing in the art of demon slaying. She is dedicated to her duty as a ninja, spending time going on missions to destroy harmful supernatural creatures.
127446: Shigaraki Koyuzu is a Tanuki yokai who was stalking Chisaki Miyazaki. After confronting Kogarashi Fuyuzora she became a resident of Yuragi-sou.
134746: An oni who works as a manga author. She loves to drink alcohol, and as she becomes more intoxicated, her power as an oni grows. She is formerly a member of the Yoinozaka (宵ノ坂 Yoinozaka) family, one of the three great families in Japan, but left the clan and pursued her passion.
134747: A timid girl who acts as a vessel for a cat god. She exhibits catlike behavior as well as having cat ears and a tail when she is possessed by it. Through their bond, she is able to call on its power whenever it is needed, and she can also warp in more cat gods through her body.
134748: Ryuuga is the head of the Ryuuga clan and the current Black Dragon God. He is the younger half-brother of Oboro.
134749: The chief retainer and the older half-sister of Genshiro Ryuga, the Black Dragon God. She is a stoic woman who moves into the Yuragi Inn after being impressed by Kogarashi's strong physical and spiritual prowess.
134750: A zashiki-warashi who is the caretaker of the Yuragi Inn. She has the power to manipulate the fortune of others, but she rarely uses it because of its potential consequences.
134751: Urara Urakata is a member of the Demon Slaying Ninja Army from the Urakata Clan and a student of Yukemuri High School.
156340: Seri Yanazawa is a student of Yukemuri High School and friend of Chisaki Miyazaki.
200034: Harumu Yumesaki is a teacher in Yukemuri High School. In reality, she's a half-succubus who wanted a peaceful normal life.
203982: She is the editor at *Monthly Shojo Marmalade* in charge of the manga artist Nonko Arahabaki. She has a serious personality and is frequently exasperated by Nonko’s heavy drinking and her tendency to only find the motivation to work when a deadline is looming.
